lastCompletedStory.title: Disambiguate the cycle-close self-handoff instruction in both agent-file copies

nextStoryContext: US-003 is a docs-only change: step 2 of the Recycle flow section in both agent copies now makes explicit that `cam journal append --cycle-close` requires a JSON journal entry piped on stdin (the single call that BOTH appends the narrative entry AND arms the recycle marker), and documents the exit-4 refuse-to-arm fallback (no live watcher: /exit manually or restart cam run). src/vendor/_generated.ts was regenerated to match. No runtime code was changed.
